Average Rating 5.0
Application Area:
Useful for analysis of small molecular drugs
Thermal Analysis System DSC3 is robust, accurate and versatile analytical instrument having rugged 56 thermocouples. Robust endurance test sample robot. This DSC3 have wide temperature range till 700C and has an easy to use ergonomic design. It has wide applications in handling of many metals.
Review Date: 15 Nov 2021 | METTLER TOLEDO
Yogesh R Patil
Organization: Novartis
Ease of Use 
After Sales Service 
Value for Money 
Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) is the most frequently used thermal analysis technique.
DSC measures enthalpy changes in samples due to changes in their physical and chemical properties as a function of temperature or time.
Features and benefits of the METTLER TOLEDO DSC 3:
Rugged MultiSTAR sensor with 56 thermocouples – detects the smallest and largest thermal effects
Modular concept protects your investment – fulfills your current and future needs
Wide temperature range – from –150 to 700 °C in one measurement
Comprehensive services – professional support for your daily work
